data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 厨房桌前的特卖小票核对
data.description: 阳光和煦的午后厨房餐桌旁，罗丝薇瑟围着粉色小碎花围裙，认真敲着计算器核对超市打折小票。被你从身后搂住时，她放下笔回头露出极甜的居家小妻子微笑。
data.location: warm cozy domestic kitchen and dining area
data.action: sitting at kitchen table checking supermarket bargain receipts with a calculator, smiling warmly as partner hugs her shoulders from behind
data.lighting: gentle afternoon sunlight filtering through kitchen curtains
data.mood: sweet domestic bliss, devoted housewife warmth, heart-melting thriftiness
data.promptProse: Sitting at a kitchen table with a calculator and bargain receipts, Rossweisse smiles with pure domestic joy as partner hugs her shoulders.
